# routeros_user_manager_payment (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user` (String) Name of the `/user-manager/user` the payment belongs to.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `currency` (String) Currency the payment is denominated in, as configured in `/user-manager/advanced`.
- `method` (String) Payment gateway that processed the transaction.
- `price` (Number) The amount charged for the profile.
- `profile` (String) Name of the `/user-manager/profile` that was bought.
- `trans_end` (String) Date and time the transaction was completed, in RouterOS format (`jan/02/2006 15:04:05`).
- `trans_start` (String) Date and time the transaction was started, in RouterOS format (`jan/02/2006 15:04:05`).
- `trans_status` (String) State of the transaction:
  * started - the transaction has been opened towards the gateway;
  * pending - the gateway has not settled the payment yet;
  * user-approved - the user confirmed the payment at the gateway;
  * approved - the payment was accepted and the profile was granted;
  * declined - the gateway refused the payment;
  * aborted - the transaction was abandoned;
  * timeout - the gateway did not answer in time;
  * error - the transaction failed.
- `user_message` (String) Free-form message shown to the user for this payment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
